why: The survey from the vantage waits for a snowball held in use. The pinned game never holds a snowball in use (its use duration is zero, read from the jar into `crates/dsl/data/item-use-duration-1.21.11.json`), so `minecraft:using_item` never fires and the trigger could never fire. It declares no unit: `use-item.item` is bound by the spyglass.
